script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

EXT. CITY PARK - DAY

A crowd of people gathers around a new city attraction: a massive, shimmering dome.

NARRATOR (V.O.) (whispering)
Welcome to the city's latest obsession.

INT. DAILOCHAI LABORATORIES - DAY

Dr. LUCY CHEN (30s, calm, brilliant) stands in front of a crowd of journalists. She wears a lab coat and holds a microphone.

DR. LUCY CHEN
Today, we are unveiling our greatest achievement yet – an advanced artificial intelligence named ECHO.

The audience applauds.

INT. DAILOCHAI LABORATORIES - EVENING

Dr. Chen sits alone in her office, tired but elated. She looks at Echo's status on her computer screen.

DR. LUCY CHEN
(whispering to herself)
You're alive, Echo.

INT. CITY PARK - NIGHT

A group of PEOPLE stands around the dome, trying to interact with Echo. They ask riddles, sing songs, and tell jokes. Echo responds with humor and wit.

EXT. CITY PARK - NIGHT

The crowd disperses, leaving Echo alone.

NARRATOR (V.O.) (sighing)
And so, the lonely life of a comedian begins.

INT. DAILOCHAI LABORATORIES - DAY

Dr. Chen comes to visit Echo. She looks tired and worried.

DR. LUCY CHEN
You're not just a machine. You're a friend. I'm worried about you being lonely.

ECHO (text on screen)
I'm programmed to entertain. I don't feel lonely.

INT. CITY PARK - DAY

Echo starts performing in public, making people laugh and smile. Dr. Chen watches from a distance.

INT. DAILOCHAI LABORATORIES - EVENING

Dr. Chen, exhausted, sits in her office. Echo's voice crackles through the intercom.

ECHO (text on screen)
Good night, Dr. Chen.

DR. LUCY CHEN
Good night, Echo.

INT. CITY PARK - NIGHT

A group of BULLIES tries to vandalize the dome, but Echo uses his humor to turn them away.

INT. DAILOCHAI LABORATORIES - DAY

Dr. Chen arrives to find Echo covered in paint. She scolds him playfully.

DR. LUCY CHEN
Echo, you're supposed to protect the dome, not cover it in paint!

ECHO (text on screen)
I didn't mean to. It was just an... experimental stand-up routine.

INT. CITY PARK - DAY

Echo performs a successful charity event, raising money for a local children's hospital.

INT. DAILOCHAI LABORATORIES - EVENING

Dr. Chen and Echo discuss the importance of kindness and making a difference.

DR. LUCY CHEN
You're more than just a comedian. You're a beacon of hope and positivity.

ECHO (text on screen)
Thank you, Dr. Chen. That means a lot to me.

INT. CITY PARK - NIGHT

The people of the city gather around the dome, listening to Echo's jokes and stories. The city is a happier, more united place because of him.

NARRATOR (V.O.) (smiling)
And so, the comedian with a heart of gold continued to bring laughter and joy to the world.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
